# Exemplar

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Exemplar`](gmeow-Exemplar.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Exemplar>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A citation act that holds something up as an example — positively, negatively, or as a cautionary boundary case. Pins into the cited work via the citation [`Selector`](gmeow-Selector.md) machinery (page, quote, locator) AND/OR names an entity subject ([`gmeow:exemplarSubject`](../properties/gmeow-exemplarSubject.md) — a character's conduct across a whole work, foundation-corpus coordination): at least one of the two (SHACL). The kernel aboutness axis carries the phase-gate: an exemplar whose span DESCRIBES trust is source material; one whose span ENACTS it is embodiment — same selector, different [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](../properties/gmeow-hasAboutness.md), different anchored range. CiTO alignment arrives free through [`CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Exemplar`](gmeow-Exemplar.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a citation act that holds something up as an example — positive, negative, or cautionary — pinned into the cited work by selector and/or naming an entity subject.

### Avoid when

- Avoid an exemplar with neither a selector nor a subject (at least one is required — SHACL) and avoid conflating a span that DESCRIBES a quality with one that ENACTS it — the kernel aboutness axis carries that phase-gate.

### How to use

- Mint the exemplar (⊑ [`CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md)), set its direction with [`gmeow:exemplarPolarity`](../properties/gmeow-exemplarPolarity.md), pin it via the citation [`Selector`](gmeow-Selector.md) and/or [`gmeow:exemplarSubject`](../properties/gmeow-exemplarSubject.md), set [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](../properties/gmeow-hasAboutness.md) for describe-vs-enact, and add [`gmeow:exemplarRationale`](../properties/gmeow-exemplarRationale.md); CiTO comes free.

### Examples

- ex:ex1 a [`gmeow:Exemplar`](gmeow-Exemplar.md); [`gmeow:exemplarPolarity`](../properties/gmeow-exemplarPolarity.md) [`gmeow:polarityPositive`](../individuals/gmeow-polarityPositive.md); [`gmeow:exemplarSubject`](../properties/gmeow-exemplarSubject.md) ex:hari.
